known_architecture_findings: sddk-cli depends on domain, engine, gateway, storage and vault and owns substantial use-case/infrastructure logic
UAT functionality is concentrated in very large domain/CLI modules
AGENTS/documentation mixes stable rules and historical/session information
PackManifest exists but is not yet the primary modular product boundary
existing_strengths: guided UAT runner with immutable SHA-256 signoff and staleness concepts
golden dataset concept and deterministic local validation philosophy
ci_observations: cloud CI workflows are intentionally manual/optional in the inspected baseline
local validation is the primary workflow authority
branch protection was observed but required status checks were not the core validation model
